principle: Academy social life is generated from real opportunities for contact. Co-location creates opportunity; only confirmed interaction creates social evidence; relationship change remains separately validated.
rules: Social opportunities exist independently of player proximity or camera observation.
Every opportunity consumes real time and requires a real accessible location.
Open gatherings permit any otherwise eligible cadet to plan attendance.
Invitation-required opportunities require represented invitation eligibility.
Finite capacity is respected; existing persisted plans consume capacity before new plans.
NPC planning may use explicit social preference tags and real social-circle context.
Species, sex category and player proximity are not selectors for ordinary non-romantic social planning.
The player is never automatically RSVP'd, auto-attending or auto-speaking.
A player invitation may be accepted, declined or left unanswered without forced replacement behavior.
Social circle membership creates encounter context only and is not a relationship state.
Plan does not prove attendance; attendance does not prove interaction; co-location does not prove conversation.
Confirmed interaction may produce familiarity/shared-history evidence but Step 9 does not directly create friendship, trust, rivalry or romance.
Romantic and sexual event generation is prohibited in Step 9.
All future romantic/sexual systems must obey gameplay/social/adult_heterosexual_relationship_canon_v0.1.json.
